name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Crayon Shin-chan Theme Songs Pack
summary:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

Crayon Shin-chan Theme Songs Pack contains 5 songs: "Kimi Ni 100Percent", "Tomoyo ~Konosakimo Zutto...", "OLA!!", "Yuru Yurude DE-O!" and "Road Movie".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
